# <module dir>:<forbidden module path regexp>
# The module graph of core carries no telemetry, transport, platform client, JsonLogic engine, schema library or other library module.
core:robfig|opentelemetry|prometheus|otelconnect|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|jsonlogic|jsonschema|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
# NFR-005: the embeddable modules are free of telemetry, transport and platform clients down to their module graphs.
evaluator/flagd:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry)/
configformat/flagd:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|jsonlogic|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator)/
# The file sync provider carries none of the other sync providers, telemetry, transport or platform clients.
sync/file:opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# gRPC is the transport of sync/flagd-grpc; it carries no other sync provider.
sync/flagd-grpc:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|http|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
# The remaining sync providers carry no other sync provider and no telemetry module. The cloud providers share
# gocloud.dev, so all three cloud SDKs stay in their module graphs (a named gap: native clients per cloud).
sync/http:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|openfeature-operator|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/openfeature-operator:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|blob|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/blob:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/gcs:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|azblob|s3|builder))
sync/azblob:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|s3|builder))
sync/s3:openfeature-relay/(telemetry|sync/(file|flagd-grpc|http|openfeature-operator|gcs|azblob|builder))
# The telemetry module carries no sync provider and no Kubernetes or gocloud client (OpenTelemetry brings a few Google auth modules).
telemetry/otel:openfeature-relay/sync/|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws
# BR-001 of UC-003: the module graph of the example sync extension is that of core.
test/sync-example:robfig|opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|open-feature/flagd/flagd|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
# The example telemetry provider requires the core only: no telemetry SDK, transport or flagd module.
test/telemetry-example:robfig|opentelemetry|google.golang.org/grpc|connectrpc.com|k8s.io|gocloud.dev|cloud.google.com|github.com/Azure|github.com/aws|prometheus|open-feature/flagd/flagd|openfeature-relay/(sync|telemetry|evaluator|configformat)/
